Description: A bounded, hand-unrolled Mandelbox-inspired sphere/box fold that makes a living fractal cage from ordinary clone positions without recursive geometry.
KScript: var phase := t*v7+u*v8; var fx := x*v0+sin(phase)*v1; var fy := y*v0+cos(phase)*v1; var fz := z*v0; var radius := sqrt(fx*fx+fy*fy+fz*fz)+0.001; var fold := clamp(v2/(radius*radius),v3,v4); fx := abs(fx*fold)-v5; fy := abs(fy*fold)-v5; fz := abs(fz*fold)-v5; radius := sqrt(fx*fx+fy*fy+fz*fz)+0.001; fold := clamp(v2/(radius*radius),v3,v4); fx := abs(fx*fold)-v5; fy := abs(fy*fold)-v5; fz := abs(fz*fold)-v5; radius := sqrt(fx*fx+fy*fy+fz*fz)+0.001; fold := clamp(v2/(radius*radius),v3,v4); fx := abs(fx*fold)-v5; fy := abs(fy*fold)-v5; fz := abs(fz*fold)-v5; var c := cos(phase); var s := sin(phase); var tx := fx*c-fy*s; var ty := fx*s+fy*c; x += tx*v6; y += ty*v6; z += fz*v6+sin(phase)*v9; rx += (fx+fy)*v8;

Variables.Name: InputScale
Variables.Tooltip: Maps world coordinates into the fold
